name: Nagumo Muneyoshi
source:
The principal of Shiromiya Academy and still an active civilian defense knight despite stepping back from the front lines.

Muneyoshi is renowned for having earned every one of the prestigious Chivalry Ten Honors, making him a legend among knights nationally and an inspiration to many students.
He's the hero who rescued young Kaname from a dangerous situation, and their bond grew stronger as he trained the protagonist in knighthood. Beyond their mentor-student relationship, they share a bond close to family, thanks to years of personal connection.

Muneyoshi's larger-than-life personality means he doesn't get bogged down by details. He's known for his hearty laughter and playful teasing, yet he's decisive when it matters. As a strict and fair educator, he champions hands-on learning, believing real-world practice is vital, making his training both practical and demanding.

As the principal, he's committed to nurturing young talent. He is the brain behind revising the knight order selection for student squires, mentoring Kaname and the group "Esquire."

"Being the only guy among five girls might sound daunting, but nah, I know you've got this!"
